teaser.en: Its fruit is much loved, yet pole cutters will not build with it, for fear it brings trouble into the home.
teaser.sw: Tunda lake linapendwa sana, lakini wakataji nguzo hawajengi nao, kwa hofu kwamba huleta matatizo nyumbani.
teaser.dg: Matundage nkumendzwa sana, ela atu anaotema nguzo taadzenga nao, kpwa kuogopha kukala unareha shida mudzini.

summary.en: *Mviru* is the wild medlar, a hairy shrub or small tree of the grassland with velvety leaves and round brownish fruit. The fruit is much relished, but people avoid using its stems as building poles.
summary.sw: *Mviru* (kwa Kiingereza *wild medlar*) ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye manyoya wa nyika ya nyasi, wenye majani laini kama mahameli na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya hudhurungi. Tunda lake hupendwa sana, lakini watu huepuka kutumia mashina yake kama nguzo za kujengea.
summary.dg: *Mviru* ni *wild medlar* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka au muhi mdide wa vuwe wenye nyere, makodza malaini sana na matunda ga mviringo ga rangi ya dongo. Matundage nkumendzwa sana, ela atu nkuhepa kuhumira mihiye dza nguzo za kudzengera.

about.en: *Mviru* is a deciduous shrub or small tree up to about 8 m, hairy all over. Its broad leaves feel soft and velvety. The round fruits ripen to a yellowish brown, with a soft, tangy pulp around a few seeds.
about.sw: *Mviru* ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaopukutika majani, wenye urefu wa hadi m 8 hivi, na wenye manyoya mwili mzima. Majani yake mapana ni laini kama mahameli yakiguswa. Matunda ya mviringo huiva kuwa rangi ya hudhurungi ya kimanjano, yakiwa na nyama laini yenye ladha ya kuchachua kidogo inayozunguka mbegu chache.
about.dg: *Mviru* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, na unakula hadi mita 8 hivi; una nyere mwiri wosi. Makodzage ni mapana, na uchigaguta ni malaini sana dza *velvet*. Matundage ga mviringo ganaivwa na kukala ga rangi ya dongo yenye mandano, na gana nyama laini ya ngbwadu kuzunguluka tembe chache.

where.en: It grows in wooded grassland and on rocky and sandy ground.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyasi zenye miti na kwenye ardhi ya mawe na ya mchanga.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye mavuwe genye mihi na phatu pha mawe na pha mtsanga.

uses.en: The fruit is much relished and eaten fresh. The stems are used for digging tools, and in some places for house poles, though Digo pole cutters avoid it. Leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Tunda hupendwa sana na huliwa vivi hivi. Mashina hutumika kutengeneza zana za kuchimbia, na katika baadhi ya maeneo hutumika kama nguzo za nyumba, ingawa wakataji nguzo wa Kidigo huuepuka. Majani na mizizi hutumika katika tiba za jadi.
uses.dg: Matundage nkumendzwa sana na nkuriwa dza garivyo. Mihiye nkuhumirwa kuhenda vyombo vya kutsimbira, na phatu phanjina kuhenda nguzo za nyumba, ela Adigo anaotema nguzo nkuuhepa. Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: Digo pole cutters avoid *mviru* as a building pole, because it is believed to bring domestic problems to the household that lives under it.
culture.sw: Wakataji nguzo wa Kidigo huepuka kutumia *mviru* kama nguzo ya kujengea, kwa sababu huaminika kuleta matatizo ya kifamilia kwa watu wanaoishi katika nyumba hiyo.
culture.dg: Adigo anaotema nguzo nkuhepa kuhumira *mviru* dza nguzo ya kudzengera, kpwa sababu nkuaminika kukala unareha shida za nyumbani kpwa mbari inayokala kpwenye nyumba iriyodzengbwa nao.

names.en: The name *mviru* is shared by Digo, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is the wild medlar; botanists call it *Vangueria infausta*.
names.sw: Jina *mviru* linatumika katika Kidigo, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza ni *wild medlar*; wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Vangueria infausta*.
names.dg: Dzina *mviru* nkuhumirwa kpwa Chidigo, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild medlar*; asayansi anauiha *Vangueria infausta*.

reason.en: Coffee-family shrub also avoided for poles, believed to split families
reason.sw: Kichaka cha familia ya mibuni ambacho pia huepukwa kwa nguzo, kikiaminika kutenganisha familia
reason.dg: *Mfumula ndolwa*, chitsaka cha jamii ya kahawa chinachohepwa piya dza nguzo, kpwa sababu nkuaminika kukala chinaganya mbari.

reason.sw: Catunaregam, wa familia ile ile ya mibuni

reason.en: Wild custard apple, another favourite bush fruit
reason.sw: Mtomoko mwitu, tunda lingine la porini linalopendwa
reason.dg: *Mbokwe*, muhi wanjina wa matunda ga weruni ganayomendzwa sana.

reason.en: Sour plum, another wild bush fruit
reason.dg: *Mtundukula*, muhi wanjina wa matunda ga weruni.
